Benchmarking Transformer Models for Fine-Grained Assamese Hate Speech Detection in Social Media
Hate speech detection in low-resource languages is a critical challenge in natural language processing, particularly for languages like Assamese that lack large-scale annotated datasets. This paper investigates the performance of transformerbased models for fine-grained, multi-class hate speech detection in Assamese social media text. We leverage an existing multi-class Assamese hate speech corpus containing $\mathbf{5, 0 0 1}$ social media comments labeled across categories such as religionbase
